t: 弗雷德里克一世在克尼格斯贝格为普鲁士国王加冕.
te: Frederick I crowns himself King in Prussia in Königsberg.
dz: 弗雷德里克一世在克尼格斯贝格为普鲁士国王加冕.
de: Frederick I crowns himself King in Prussia in Königsberg.

t: 萨法维德部队从巴士拉撤退,结束了长达三年的占领.
te: Safavid troops retreat from Basra, ending a three-year occupation.
dz: 萨法维德部队从巴士拉撤退,结束了长达三年的占领.
de: Safavid troops retreat from Basra, ending a three-year occupation.

t: 在卡皮战役中由尼古拉斯·卡蒂纳特(英语:Nicolas Catinat)手下的一支波旁部队从萨…
te: A Bourbon force under Nicolas Catinat withdraws from a smaller Habsburg force under Prince Eugene of Savoy in the Battl…
dz: 在卡皮战役中由尼古拉斯·卡蒂纳特(英语:Nicolas Catinat)手下的一支波旁部队从萨伏伊亲王尤金(英语:Eugene of Savoy)手下规模较小的哈布斯堡部队中撤退.
de: A Bourbon force under Nicolas Catinat withdraws from a smaller Habsburg force under Prince Eugene of Savoy in the Battle of Carpi.

t: 易洛魁邦联的代表签署"南凡条约",将俄亥俄河以北的大片领土割让给英国.
te: Representatives of the Iroquois Confederacy sign the Nanfan Treaty, ceding a large territory north of the Ohio River to…
dz: 易洛魁邦联的代表签署"南凡条约",将俄亥俄河以北的大片领土割让给英国.
de: Representatives of the Iroquois Confederacy sign the Nanfan Treaty, ceding a large territory north of the Ohio River to England.

t: 安托万·德·拉·莫特·卡迪拉克(英语:Antoine de la Mothe Cadillac…
te: Antoine de la Mothe Cadillac founds the trading post at Fort Pontchartrain, which later becomes the city of Detroit.
dz: 安托万·德·拉·莫特·卡迪拉克(英语:Antoine de la Mothe Cadillac)在庞特恰特雷恩堡发现了交易站,该站后来成为了底特律市.
de: Antoine de la Mothe Cadillac founds the trading post at Fort Pontchartrain, which later becomes the city of Detroit.

t: 新法兰西和第一民族之间的蒙特利尔大和平签署.
te: Great Peace of Montreal between New France and First Nations is signed.
dz: 新法兰西和第一民族之间的蒙特利尔大和平签署.
de: Great Peace of Montreal between New France and First Nations is signed.

t: 詹姆斯·弗朗西斯·爱德华·斯图亚特(英语:James Francis Edward Stuar…
te: James Francis Edward Stuart, sometimes called the "Old Pretender", becomes the Jacobite claimant to the thrones of Engl…
dz: 詹姆斯·弗朗西斯·爱德华·斯图亚特(英语:James Francis Edward Stuart),有时被称作"老伪装者",在他父亲詹姆斯二世去世后成为了英国和苏格兰王位上雅各派的求偿人.
de: James Francis Edward Stuart, sometimes called the "Old Pretender", becomes the Jacobite claimant to the thrones of England and Scotland on the death of his father, James II.

t: 康涅狄格学院（后更名为耶鲁大学）在康涅狄格州老塞布鲁克成立。
te: The Collegiate School of Connecticut (later renamed Yale University) is chartered in Old Saybrook, Connecticut.
dz: 康涅狄格学院（后更名为耶鲁大学）在康涅狄格州老塞布鲁克成立。
de: The Collegiate School of Connecticut (later renamed Yale University) is chartered in Old Saybrook, Connecticut.
